description: This header defines optimized non-temporal memory copy functions using SIMD instructions (SSE, AVX) for efficient large data transfers, with platform-specific intrinsics and fallback.

methods.name: non_temporal_store_memcpy
methods.description: Performs non-temporal memory copy using SIMD instructions, optimized for aligned and unaligned addresses, with platform-specific intrinsics.

methods.name: non_temporal_store_memcpy_avx
methods.description: Performs non-temporal memory copy using AVX instructions, optimized for large data blocks.
